name: open-seo
description: Open source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs
readmeExcerpt: # OpenSEO > Open source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs OpenSEO is an SEO tool for _the people_. If tools like Semrush or Ahrefs are too expensive or bloated, OpenSEO is a pay-as-you-go alternative that you actually control. > All-in-one SEO tool for you and your AI agent. Connect with any agent like Claude Code, OpenClaw or Hermes. We have pre-built skills, but you can build your own to tailor OpenSEO to your needs. ## Hosted Version Try OpenSEO for free on our website. If you want to support the project, a hosted subscription is $10/month. [openseo.so](https://openseo.so) ## Why use OpenSEO? - Best in class MCP and AI Skills. - Modern, simple UI. - Focused workflows instead of a bloated, complex SEO suite. - No subscriptions. - Bring your own DataForSEO API key and pay only for what you use. - Fork and vibe code your own custom tool. ## Main SEO Workflows - Keyword research - Rank tracking - Competitor Insights - Backlinks - Site Audits - AI Visibility ## OpenSEO MCP & Agent Skills OpenSEO exposes an MCP server so AI agents like Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Hermes can use your SEO data directly. Agent Skills are reusable workflows that guide your agent through SEO tasks using the MCP. - [Set up ChatGPT web or desktop](https://openseo.so/docs/chatgpt) (works on Free and paid ChatGPT plans) - [Set up Codex](https://openseo.so/docs/codex-plugin) - [Set up OpenSEO MCP](https://openseo.so/docs/mcp) - [Set up OpenSEO Agent Skills](https://openseo.so/docs/skills/setup) ## Self-Hosting ### Recommended: EveryApp EveryApp simplifies self hosting open source apps + personal software. It runs entirely in your Cloudflare account on their $5/month plan. It's also the company behind OpenSEO. OpenSEO actually started out because I was trying to do SEO for EveryApp. But, then people loved it so much that we paused EveryApp for a while. We've since relaunched it and think it's the best way to self host OpenSEO. https://everyapp.com/docs/apps/openseo ```bash npm install -g everyapp everyapp setup --domain apps.yourcompany.com everyapp install https://github.com/every-app/open-seo ``` ### DataForSEO API Key You need a DataForSEO API key to get SEO data, or a [treg](https://treg.to) account which also gives access to DataForSEO. See [`docs/DATAFORSEO_API_KEY.md`](./docs/DATAFORSEO_API_KEY.md). ### Other options OpenSEO also supports two standalone self-hosting paths. Both use email and password accounts: the first visitor creates the admin account, teammates join from invitation links, and MCP clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor) sign in with the same accounts. - **Docker** - On your own server or computer, with a prebuilt image that is ready in seconds. Works with Compose-based platforms such as Coolify, Portainer and Dokploy. See [`docs/SELF_HOSTING_DOCKER.md`](./docs/SELF_HOSTING_DOCKER.md). - Running the older single-container image? It keeps getting updates; [move to the new setup](./docs/SELF_HOSTING_DOCKER.md#move-from-the-old-docker-image) when you are ready, data included. - **Cloudflare** - Self host on Cloudflare, but not with EveryApp. See [`docs/SELF_HOSTING_CLOUDFLARE.md`](./docs/SELF_HOSTING_CLOUDFLARE.md). For security-conscious setups, two advanced options replace the accounts with your own network controls: - **Cloudflare Access** in front of the Cloudflare deploy, so Cloudflare checks every request before it reaches OpenSEO. See [`docs/SELF_HOSTING_CLOUDFLARE.md`](./docs/SELF_HOSTING_CLOUDFLARE.md). - **No sign-in on Docker**, behind Tailscale, a private network or your own authenticating proxy. See [Without sign-in](./docs/SELF_HOSTING_DOCKER.md#without-sign-in-advanced). ## Costs OpenSEO needs a [DataForSEO](https://dataforseo.com/?aff=255379) API key so that you can get SEO data. You pay them directly when self hosting. See [openseo.so/pricing](https://openseo.so/pricing) When you self host, your costs will be slightly lower than the estimates on our website. The way the hosted service makes money is by charging 28% extra for every request we make to DataForSEO. ## Local Development See [`docs/LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT.md`](./docs/LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT.md). ## Contributing Creating clear issues is the best way to contribute. Read more here: [`.github/CONTRIBUTING.md`](./.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) We have this skill: `/simple-issue-description` which helps. ```sh npx skills add every-app/open-seo --skill simple-issue-description ``` ## Community Join Discord to chat: [Discord](https://discord.gg/c9uGs3cFXr) Follow along for updates: - Follow on X: https://x.com/bensenescu - Sign up for the mailing list on our website: [openseo.so](https://openseo.so)

aiSummary.oneLiner: Open-source, pay-as-you-go alternative to heavy SEO suites like Semrush and Ahrefs.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: OpenSEO is an all-in-one SEO tool designed for individual users and AI agents to perform focused search engine optimization workflows. Instead of locking users into expensive monthly subscriptions, it utilizes a bring-your-own-key model with DataForSEO to provide granular, pay-as-you-go data access. The platform features a modern web UI for tasks like keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, and backlink analysis. Crucially, it exposes a built-in Model Context Protocol server, allowing AI agents like Claude Code or OpenClaw to directly interact with live SEO data and execute pre-built agent skills. It supports both simple Docker deployments and advanced internet-facing Cloudflare setups for easy self-hosting.
keyFeatures: Pay-As-You-Go Architecture: Operates on a bring-your-own-key model using DataForSEO, eliminating expensive recurring subscriptions.
Native MCP Server: Exposes live SEO data directly to AI agents via the Model Context Protocol for automated workflows.
Comprehensive SEO Workflows: Includes dedicated tools for keyword research, backlink analysis, site audits, and rank tracking.
AI Agent Skills: Provides pre-built skills that guide compatible AI agents through complex SEO analysis tasks.
Flexible Self-Hosting: Supports local deployment via Docker or secure, internet-facing hosting using Cloudflare.

releases.name: v0.1.31
releases.body:
Redesigned GSC Insights, moving self-hosted installs to Every App, and local search volume in MCP.

## What's new

- Redesigned GSC Insights
  - Click any query or page to see its own trend
- Move a self-hosted install to Every App from Settings
  - Both installs must run the same version
- Search volume for a city, county or region in the `get_keyword_metrics` MCP tool

## Fixed

- Embed links now open Rank Tracking on the project's own site, not a competitor's.
- The Backlink growth chart now ends with today's totals, matching the table beside it.
- AI visibility checks no longer stop partway through on Cloudflare self-hosts using Workers Paid.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/every-app/open-seo/compare/v0.1.30...v0.1.31

releases.name: v0.1.30
releases.body:
Embed links for other dashboards, plus keyword, site audit and Docker fixes.

## What's new

- Embed a project's live rankings and Search Console data in other dashboards, like GoHighLevel
  - In Project settings → Integrations (self-hosted installs need `AUTH_MODE=password`)

## Fixed

- Keyword Research no longer shows keywords in title case.
- Site audits no longer analyze a "Checking your browser" page as if it were the site.
- In the Docker setup, a bad treg token or empty treg balance now says so instead of showing a confusing error.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/every-app/open-seo/compare/v0.1.29...v0.1.30

releases.name: v0.1.29
releases.body:
Rank checks that replace incomplete Google results, plus Discover report and Docker fixes.

## What's new

- Rank checks now detect and replace incomplete Google results
  - Some positions may show lower than before, correcting earlier checks that over-reported them.

## Fixed

- Switching Search Performance to Discover while a device filter is on no longer breaks the page.
- Self-hosting with a treg account now works in the standalone Docker setup.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/every-app/open-seo/compare/v0.1.28...v0.1.29

releases.name: v0.1.28
releases.body:
Google AI Mode in Prompt Tracking, movable local rank grids, and site audit path exclusions.

## What's new

- Track Google AI Mode in Prompt Tracking
- Move a local rank grid's center on a map
- Exclude URL paths from a site audit
- Edit Prompt Research keywords, in the app or with the new `update_ai_research_keywords` MCP tool
- More countries, including Somalia and Macao
- Self-host with a treg account instead of a DataForSEO account — thanks @JayZeeDesign
  - Set `TREG_API_TOKEN` in place of `DATAFORSEO_API_KEY`

## Fixed

- City and region search volume now works in Hong Kong, Taiwan, Israel and five other countries.
- Rank checks delayed by the search data provider keep waiting instead of failing, and the page says so.
- Connecting OpenSEO in ChatGPT or Claude again no longer signs out your earlier connection.
- The rank tracking table is now paged and no longer freezes on large trackers.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/every-app/open-seo/compare/v0.1.27...v0.1.28

releases.name: v0.1.27
releases.body:
Delete Local SEO businesses and change their area, Lighthouse results over MCP, and more complete site audits.

## What's new

- Delete a tracked business or change its area in Local SEO
- Read Lighthouse results with the new `get_audit_lighthouse` MCP tool
- Audits that stop at their page limit now say so
- `finalUrls` option on `get_serp_results` for page URLs instead of Google redirect links
  - Takes a few minutes instead of seconds

## Fixed

- Site audits that hit their page limit no longer use it up on tag pages and skip pages in your sitemap.
- Site audits no longer report a site's bot-check page as the real page.
- Keyword Research shows the keyword you searched in the overview card.
- `get_local_rank_grid` no longer counts a similarly named business as yours when you give its cid.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/every-app/open-seo/compare/v0.1.26...v0.1.27

readmeHtml:
OpenSEO

Open source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs

OpenSEO is an SEO tool for the people. If tools like Semrush or Ahrefs are too expensive or bloated, OpenSEO is a pay-as-you-go alternative that you actually control.

All-in-one SEO tool for you and your AI agent.

Connect with any agent like Claude Code, OpenClaw or Hermes. We have pre-built skills, but you can build your own to tailor OpenSEO to your needs.

Hosted Version

Try OpenSEO for free on our website. If you want to support the project, a hosted subscription is $10/month.

openseo.so

Why use OpenSEO?

  • Best in class MCP and AI Skills.
  • Modern, simple UI.
    • Focused workflows instead of a bloated, complex SEO suite.
  • No subscriptions.
    • Bring your own DataForSEO API key and pay only for what you use.
  • Fork and vibe code your own custom tool.

Main SEO Workflows

  • Keyword research
  • Rank tracking
  • Competitor Insights
  • Backlinks
  • Site Audits
  • AI Visibility

OpenSEO MCP & Agent Skills

OpenSEO exposes an MCP server so AI agents like Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Hermes can use your SEO data directly. Agent Skills are reusable workflows that guide your agent through SEO tasks using the MCP.

  • Set up ChatGPT web or desktop (works on Free and paid ChatGPT plans)
  • Set up Codex
  • Set up OpenSEO MCP
  • Set up OpenSEO Agent Skills

Self-Hosting

Recommended: EveryApp

EveryApp simplifies self hosting open source apps + personal software. It runs entirely in your Cloudflare account on their $5/month plan.

It's also the company behind OpenSEO. OpenSEO actually started out because I was trying to do SEO for EveryApp. But, then people loved it so much that we paused EveryApp for a while. We've since relaunched it and think it's the best way to self host OpenSEO.

https://everyapp.com/docs/apps/openseo

npm install -g everyapp
everyapp setup --domain apps.yourcompany.com
everyapp install https://github.com/every-app/open-seo

DataForSEO API Key

You need a DataForSEO API key to get SEO data, or a treg account which also gives access to DataForSEO. See docs/DATAFORSEO_API_KEY.md.

Other options

OpenSEO also supports two standalone self-hosting paths. Both use email and password accounts: the first visitor creates the admin account, teammates join from invitation links, and MCP clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor) sign in with the same accounts.

  • Docker - On your own server or computer, with a prebuilt image that is ready in seconds. Works with Compose-based platforms such as Coolify, Portainer and Dokploy. See docs/SELF_HOSTING_DOCKER.md.
    • Running the older single-container image? It keeps getting updates; move to the new setup when you are ready, data included.
  • Cloudflare - Self host on Cloudflare, but not with EveryApp. See docs/SELF_HOSTING_CLOUDFLARE.md.

For security-conscious setups, two advanced options replace the accounts with your own network controls:

  • Cloudflare Access in front of the Cloudflare deploy, so Cloudflare checks every request before it reaches OpenSEO. See docs/SELF_HOSTING_CLOUDFLARE.md.
  • No sign-in on Docker, behind Tailscale, a private network or your own authenticating proxy. See Without sign-in.

Costs

OpenSEO needs a DataForSEO API key so that you can get SEO data. You pay them directly when self hosting.

See openseo.so/pricing

When you self host, your costs will be slightly lower than the estimates on our website. The way the hosted service makes money is by charging 28% extra for every request we make to DataForSEO.

Local Development

See docs/LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT.md.

Contributing

Creating clear issues is the best way to contribute.

Read more here: .github/CONTRIBUTING.md

We have this skill: /simple-issue-description which helps.

npx skills add every-app/open-seo --skill simple-issue-description

Community

Join Discord to chat: Discord

Follow along for updates:

  • Follow on X: https://x.com/bensenescu
  • Sign up for the mailing list on our website: openseo.so
